info.title: Evalezy AI Evaluation API
info.description:
Create exams, register candidates, submit scanned answer copies or typed answers, and read question-wise AI marks with feedback. Results are drafts until you finalize them.

Server-to-server only: never ship an API key inside a browser or mobile app. English answers only for now (Hindi and regional languages are on the roadmap).

put.description:
Sets or clears one long-answer question's rubric and/or model answer. Send `{"rubric": null}` to clear the rubric. The same rules as [Update several rubrics](/api-reference/rubrics/update-several) apply.

**Scope:** `evaluation:write`

**Beta, enabled on request.** Choice groups are currently switched off, so this endpoint returns 422 `feature_not_available`; send papers without internal choice for now, or contact hello@evalezy.com if you need them.

When enabled, it replaces every choice group of the exam ("attempt any N of M"). Each group lists at least two question labels, `attempt` (at least 1 and less than the group size) and `policy` (`first` or `best`). The response carries `choice_groups`, `total_marks` and `paper_max`.

**Scope:** `evaluation:write`

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Any unique string of 1-255 printable ASCII characters (a UUID works). Retrying with the same key within 48 hours replays the first response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

post.description:
Returns presigned upload URLs for one PDF (top-level fields) or up to 100 PDFs (`files`). Each URL is valid for 1 hour. PUT the raw file bytes to `upload_url` with the returned `headers`, then pass the upload `id` as `upload_id` when you submit.

PDF only, up to 50 MB each. Image types return 422 `feature_not_available`. On an idempotent replay the URLs are not repeated (`upload_url_redacted: true`); request new uploads instead.

**Scope:** `evaluation:write`

post.description:
Creates an exam with its questions, and optionally registers candidates in the same call. The exam starts as a `draft`; send `open: true` to open it right away (or call [Open an exam](/api-reference/exams/open) later).

- `mode` is `handwritten` (scanned PDF copies) or `typed` (answers sent as text).
- `external_ref` is your own id for the exam. A second create with the same value returns 409 `exam_exists` with `details.exam_id`, so you can safely look it up instead.
- Long-answer questions with neither a rubric nor a model answer get an `auto_rubric` warning.
- Only English is supported (`answer_language: en`).
- `choice_groups` is beta and enabled on request; until then it returns 422 `feature_not_available`.

The response includes the exam's `quote` (credits per page or per answer) and any `warnings`. Exams created through the API also appear in your dashboard, tagged Source: API.

**Scope:** `evaluation:write`

post.description:
Submits one candidate's work for AI evaluation and returns `202` with the submission and its fixed-price `quote`.

- **Handwritten exams:** send `upload_id` of a `ready` upload. Copies of up to 40 pages are read normally; 41 to 80 pages are accepted but flagged for review (`pages_beyond_vision_limit`); more than 80 pages return 422 `too_many_pages`.
- **Typed exams:** send `answers`, each keyed by `question_id` or `question_label`. Long answers are plain text up to 20,000 characters. An answer in which more than 20% of the letters are Devanagari returns 422 `language_not_supported`.

Identify the candidate with `candidate_id` or an inline `candidate` (created and registered if new). One live submission per candidate per exam: a second one returns 409 `submission_exists` unless you send `replace: true`. The exam must be open (409 `exam_not_open`).

**Scope:** `evaluation:write`

post.description:
Publishes AI draft marks as final. Send `submission_ids` (up to 500) or `all_graded: true`. Graded submissions are finalized; `partially_graded` and `failed` ones only with `allow_partial` (failed questions count 0); queued or running ones are skipped. After finalize, overrides and re-evaluate return 409 `submission_finalized` until you unfinalize. Finalizing sends no emails or notifications.

**Scope:** `evaluation:finalize`

patch.description:

patch.description:
Sets or clears the rubric and/or model answer of several long-answer questions in one version bump. The body maps question ids to `{rubric, model_answer}`; send `null` to clear one.

Criterion marks must add up to the question's max marks (422 `rubric_marks_mismatch`), names must be unique (422 `rubric_duplicate_criterion`) and guidance must not contain mark figures (422 `rubric_guidance_has_marks`). Send `If-Match` with the version you read to avoid overwriting someone else's change.

**Scope:** `evaluation:write`

**Scope:** `evaluation:write`

criteria.description: Up to 30 criteria. Names unique within the question; marks add up to the question's `max_marks`.

option_labels.description: MCQ and true/false: the chosen option labels.

candidate.description: Inline candidate (created or updated by `external_id`). Send this or `candidate_id`.

upload_id.description: Handwritten exams: the id of a `ready` upload.

replace.description: Replace the candidate's existing live submission (not allowed once finalized).

metadata.description: A JSON object of your own, up to 2 KB, returned on the submission.

answers.description: Typed exams: one entry per answered question.

submission_ids.description: Up to 500 submission ids. Send this or `all_graded`.

allow_partial.description: Also finalize `partially_graded` and `failed` submissions; failed questions count 0.

upload_ids.description: Quote the exact pages of 1 to 100 uploads.

typed_answers.description: Quote this many non-blank long answers.

awarded.description: New marks, between 0 and the question's max, in steps of 0.5.

reason.description: Why the marks changed, up to 500 characters.

Error.description: Every error uses this envelope. Branch on `error.code`; the message is for humans.

message.example: questions[1].max_marks must be a multiple of 0.5.

request_id.description: Quote this when you contact support (also sent as the X-Request-Id header).

details.description: Extra context. For `validation_failed`, `details.errors` lists every failing field.

state.description: `live` for the current submission; `replaced` or `deleted` otherwise.

pages.description: Page count of the handwritten copy.

attempt_count.description: How many evaluation runs this submission has had.

credits_charged.description: Charged credits once graded; 0 for a typed submission with only objective answers; null while running or when failed/cancelled.

submission_id.description: The submission that used this upload.

expires_at.description: When the upload URL stops working.

id.description: Upload id. Pass it as `upload_id` when you submit.

upload_url.description: Presigned URL. PUT the raw PDF bytes here with the returned headers.

headers.description: Send these headers with the PUT.

expires_at.description: The URL is valid for 1 hour.

upload_url_redacted.description: Only on an idempotent replay: the URL is not repeated. Request a new upload.

counted.description: False when the answer does not count towards the total.

source.description: `ai`, `ai_reviewed` (a teacher edited it) or `auto` (objective answer scored by key).

extracted_answer.description: What the AI read (on by default; `include=-extracted_answer` turns it off).

committed.description: Credits quoted for your queued and running evaluations.

finalized.description: Submission ids finalized by this call.

has_more.description: With `all_graded`, true when more than 500 were eligible: call again.

sync.description: `pending` when the change is saved but still syncing.

questions.description: PATCH: one entry per changed question.
